query_interface.note: the conservative one-minute interface; this is not a state that uses every bit of information available exactly at the event onset

H2a_A.task_name: fine identity given the event size or coarse composition
H2a_A.caveat: K_c and the community sizes are supplied at scoring time; this is not an unconditional forecast of the full contact set

wrong_time.incoherence: the donor state is paired with the recipient explicit history; a large distance means the swap is out of distribution rather than merely mistimed

donor_matching.interpretation: tests time correspondence only; it cannot on its own establish history integration or a causal role, and it is not a global admission gate

thinning.rule: fixed time-ordered stride chosen before any score is read

H2a_B.interface_note: the free-continuation arm needed an initial-state argument that the frozen rollout helper does not expose; rollout_with_h0 copies every decision rule verbatim and adds only that argument

S_A.interpretation: per-coordinate signed differences against matched controls; the overall magnitude is non-negative by construction and is not a positivity verdict. Within-case queries are equally weighted and seizures are grouped into clusters; reused controls are not independent seizures and rare seizures do not manufacture cohort significance.

S_B.measurement: 1-150 Hz baseline robust-z activation, clinical onset [0,10] seconds, CAR
S_B.primary: within-community Spearman on identical valid contacts, equal weight over qualified communities
S_B.limitation: only communities with at least three valid contacts are defined; the all-contact Spearman is retained as the legacy convention and carries a cross-community offset bias that the conditional likelihood does not identify
S_B.interpretation: a frozen interictal contact readout compared with a separately measured ictal spatial field; it is not EEG-onset forecasting, not an ictally trained decoder and not propagation

S_C.reason: no complete prospective observable person-hour denominator, event annotation and legal time validation are registered for this window
S_C.blocks_only: S-C; S-A and S-B are unaffected

weighting.dependence: 2-hour paired time blocks by default, 4-hour sensitivity, per-day listing
weighting.units: queries, events and optimizer seeds are not patients

reading_rules: a rich advantage together with a long-history advantage does not by itself show that the earlier rich content contributes; that claim needs the matched training experiment registered for the next package
the five differences are reported separately and are never summed into one rich-state score
E1125 is development material throughout; nothing here is an independent confirmation
